rows.disposition: Funded nine-decimal child deployment replaces LP-valued/unfunded minting. Deterministic deployment, custom/default metadata and funded first-bond custody remain tested.
Fixed eight-hour first-bond boundaries replace configurable epochs/Open mode and caps. Zero eligibility consumes boundaries without issuing rewards.
Independent purchased U and liquidity G replace the assumption U equals G; the equal-input vector preserves the original split.
Funded child deployment and actual protocol LP custody replace virtual id-0 LP entitlements; direct externally owned LP donation is tested across four bindings and both policies.
D32 retires pending LP redemption/rejoin and residual swaps from sDETF exits. Four common funded unstake tests are inherited by the retained concrete host/native-unit fixtures.
Stake redemption is funded 1:1 and independent of reserve price gating; the existing policy fixtures retain the standard-route assertion.
Linear vesting replaces maturity-only selling; rewards remain claimable while locked and all payouts are funded sDETF.
Owner-approved mature-close retirement replaces basket liquidation with funded claims followed by optional standard unstaking. Holder/operator/recipient and prior-inventory controls remain.
Owner-approved removal of closeRouteMode/closeRoutes retires obsolete close-array validation; malformed legacy deployment payloads now fail canonical decoding.
